prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Toma Bellbreak. Character visual motifs: compact older bell-trained martial artist with heavy bronze wrist bells, battered red canvas and a rooted deliberate stance; no point-click allyward kick ultimate.
TOP LEFT: Listen for the Stroke. Ability concept: an enemy in 105 GU starting a cast with visible windup grants Toma a public Bell Window until commit (max one tracked per enemy). His next basic attack within 1.2 s after that cast's completion restores 5% missing HP, once / enemy / 6 s.
TOP RIGHT: Open Palm. Ability concept: a short 60-GU palm strike that deals modest damage; if it hits during a visible enemy windup, it **does not interrupt**, but grants Toma a parry charge valid 3 s.
BOTTOM LEFT: Return Stroke. Ability concept: consumes parry charge (or performs a weak dry guard) to create a 0.6 s frontal reaction stance. One incoming targeted non-ultimate hit from that frontal arc is partially reduced; after it lands Toma counterstrikes the attacker for moderate damage. Guard is ineffective from behind and against untargeted AoE.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Thirteenth Bell. Ability concept: sets a 1.2 s public dueling rhythm centered on Toma; opponents hear two false chimes then one genuine **final** counter window. If an enemy finishes a damaging cast against Toma during the final 0.25 s, that damage is reduced 35% (not negated) and he sends a non-stunning shockwave outward. Casting earlier or attacking someone else avoids the counter.
